units.source_text: 源氏公子舍舟登陆，改乘车子的时候，正值朝日初升。

en.t: When Prince Genji left the boat and came ashore, changing to a carriage, the morning sun was just beginning to rise.

units.source_text: 明石道人在阳光之下望见源氏公子的神态，竟忘记了自身年老，似觉寿命延长了，笑容满面，只管合掌礼拜住吉明神。

en.t: Seeing Prince Genji's bearing in the sunlight, the Akashi monk forgot even his own old age and felt as though his life had been lengthened; with his face full of smiles, he could only press his palms together and worship the Sumiyoshi deity.

units.source_text: 他仿佛获得了一颗夜明珠，当然尽心竭力地关心照拂源氏公子了。

en.t: It was as if he had obtained a precious night-shining pearl, and of course he devoted all his strength and care to looking after Prince Genji.
